text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. So the pool facility I 
recommended before was of some help, 
then?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to the floating obstacle 
course, I've built up my core, so my 
running form should see a huge improvement 
too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek was having fun with it too. She 
seemed especially fond of the sea turtle 
pool float.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even during break time, she just sat on 
top of the sea turtle, rocking back and 
forth with a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she's working super hard on her 
wave pool training!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The assignment to swim across against the 
waves... No matter how many times I 
failed, I kept trying without giving up! 
In the end, I even cleared the biggest 
wave!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Bitter Glace was the same way. Once 
she conquered the waves, she did time 
trial after time trial, striving to go 
even faster next time.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Bitter Glace-san. Looks 
like Meek's motivation switch got flipped 
too, seeing as she even challenged the 
water slide on her own...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Same here. The girls on our team also 
seemed to have a blast going down the 
slide over and over. ...Ah, though—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon was different. She came up to 
me and asked... if I'd like to play in the 
shallow pool with her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon-san did...? That's a bit 
unexpected...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
People often misunderstand her, but... 
she's surprisingly attentive. Back then, 
too, she was likely looking out for me 
since I cannot swim.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...As expected of Trainer Kashimoto. The 
bond of trust with your trainee is so 
solid... Could you please teach me your 
secret, too!?"
